journey.name: move to spark
journey.description:
Verifies the "Update Spending Balance" modal and the move behind it. With an LDK channel that can send at least 1,000 sats and Spark connected, Home shows the modal once (testTag "UpdateSpendingBalance"); Spending and Lightning Connections show a "Move To Spark" button (testTag "MoveToSpark") that opens the same modal while the channel can still send. The modal quotes the routing fee over the channel only and shows it as "Update fee: up to " in the primary currency (testTag "UpdateSpendingBalanceUpdate" is the Update button, loading while it quotes and moves). Update pays the whole balance to new invoices of the user's own Spark wallet, splitting it into parts by itself when one payment does not route, and shows "Spending Balance Updated" (testTag "SpendingBalanceUpdated"). Once the move settles, the app closes the emptied channel cooperatively in the background, which writes a transfer to Savings. A wallet without such a channel never gets the modal or the button.
A split needs a route that cannot carry the balance in one payment; on a direct channel to the Spark service provider every amount routes, so the split is covered by the repository's unit tests rather than here.
Precondition: dev build pointed at a local Spark regtest (spark-sdk regtest/local), and a wallet with an open channel to that stack's SSP Lightning node that holds most of its capacity on the wallet's side (open it from Lightning Connections, Manual Setup, with the node URI the stack prints). Start on the wallet home screen with the app freshly launched.

actions.action: Wait on Home and verify the "Update Spending Balance" modal (testTag "UpdateSpendingBalance") shows "UPDATE SPENDING BALANCE" and "Bitkit is switching Lightning providers. Update your spending balance to continue making instant, cheap payments." followed by "Update fee: up to " and an amount
Tap "Later" (testTag "UpdateSpendingBalanceLater") and verify the modal closes
Relaunch the app, wait on Home and verify the modal does not show again
Open the Spending wallet and verify the "Move To Spark" button (testTag "MoveToSpark") shows
Tap "Move To Spark" and verify the "Update Spending Balance" modal opens and shows "Update fee: up to " with an amount once the Update button (testTag "UpdateSpendingBalanceUpdate") stops loading

Tap "Update" and verify the modal titled "Spending Balance Updated" (testTag "SpendingBalanceUpdated") shows "SPENDING BALANCE UPDATED" and "Your spending balance has been successfully migrated to Spark, Bitkit’s new Lightning service provider."
Tap "OK" (testTag "SpendingBalanceUpdatedOk") and verify the modal closes

Open Settings › Advanced › Lightning Connections and verify the channel is closing or closed, and that it shows no channel under OPEN CONNECTIONS, only Spark via Breez, whose balance grew by the moved amount

Go back to Home and verify Activity lists a "Move to Spark" transfer row with the moved amount plus the routing fee, whose detail screen is titled "Move to Spark", and a transfer to Savings for the closed channel
Open Spending and verify the "Move To Spark" button is gone
